why_this_is_new_information: The fixed candidate candidate-ledgers can now be paired against exact lower-exposure control lifecycles that were admitted, completed and cost-stressed at the same component, timestamp, direction, feature and entry price.
Unit 061 measured a P4 candidate funnel and quarantined an invalid slot sum; it did not observe the terminal economics of the candidate's blocked opportunities.
Unit 077 isolated Passive pending-reservation arithmetic in five expired-pending passed signals; it neither valued the all-component block population nor supplied multi-period completed controls.

Unit 118 rejected a mechanical 0.12 factor-cap explanation of the August worst day and explicitly lacked counterfactual terminal decisions. This unit supplies exact paired terminal decisions across E1-E4, June, July and August without reopening that worst-day or factor-cap question.

central_question: Across the fixed selection population, do exact lower-exposure control lifecycles paired to aggregate-risk-blocked fixed-candidate opportunities carry broad and economically material direct shadow value, and does the same sign survive June-July plus August strongly enough to retain exactly one later shared-account admission-displacement causal question?

paired_control.role: Exact Live-derived lower-exposure control whose admitted lifecycle supplies the paired realized outcome; it is not a proposed replacement.

additional_exactness: positive candidate/control volume and positive attempted/planned risk
fixed_population.unmatched_rule: Retain as structurally unmatched and impute no outcome.

fixed_economic_estimator.quality_r: paired control actual or stressed net divided by paired control planned risk
reports: paired-control and candidate-volume-shadow actual/stressed net and profit factor
mean and median paired-control R plus shadow net divided by candidate attempted risk
period, book and component stressed net and sign breadth
fixed_economic_estimator.causal_limit: Direct shadow value at the paired control lifecycle's realized exit geometry, linearly scaled to candidate volume. Every blocked candidate records stop_loss=0 because admission failed before a realized protective stop existed. The estimator therefore does not identify the candidate's own stop/exit path and does not simulate incumbent displacement, later admissions, margin, open-equity drawdown, sequence-dependent capital or a realizable cap change.

selection_favorable_gates_all_required.shadow_stressed_net_usd: >= 109.55048, exactly 2% of the fixed candidate's $5,477.524 selection stressed anchor

confirmation_open_rule: Aggregate forward and August close economics only if every selection favorable gate passes.

decision_translation.confirmed_favorable: Preserve the fixed candidate and retain exactly one non-automatic Lab seed asking a full shared-account admission-displacement causal question. Do not relax a cap or alter priority from this shadow estimator.
decision_translation.selection_only_or_ambiguous: Preserve the fixed candidate, retain no seed and rotate away without subgroup, threshold, component, period or cap rescue.
decision_translation.strong_adverse: Preserve the fixed candidate and current blocking geometry; retain no relaxation seed.
decision_translation.invalid: Correct environment, design or engineering until one complete valid aggregation exists; issue no economic-failure verdict.

forbidden_rescues: best period, month, book, component, direction, volume-ratio, attempted-risk-ratio or exit-class selection
neighboring position risk, aggregate cap, weight, slot, priority, reservation, ladder, exposure or sizing grid
reinterpretation as realized candidate stop behavior, shared-account value, drawdown or automatic cap authority
MQL, compile, Proxy sweep, Tester, MT5, broker/account/position/order/deal query, Live or Master mutation
commit_policy: The receipt, declaration, one valid aggregation, closure, whole-map comparison and state updates form one research unit and are committed and pushed once at closure.
next: Execute the pinned analysis once; open confirmation economics only on a complete favorable selection gate.
